meta.name: task-decomposition-checkpointing
meta.description: Break requests into small checkpoints with verify steps and stop-on-fail behavior. Use when tasks span multiple files or systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂任务拆解为可验证的小步骤，失败自动停止
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个文件或系统间协调执行任务
copy.tagline_en: Break complex tasks into verifiable checkpoints with automatic stop on failure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate tasks across multiple files or systems

howto.what: Claude 会把你的请求拆成多个小检查点，每步完成后自动验证，验证失败就停止并上报，避免一次改太多出问题。
howto.when: 当你的任务涉及多个文件或系统时，Claude 会按协议自动启用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我重构用户模块，分步骤验证。
say.note: Claude 会生成检查点列表并逐步执行。

say.text: 修改配置文件，每改一步都检查语法。
say.note: Claude 会在每个检查点后运行验证命令。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks your request into small checkpoints, each with a verify step. It stops and escalates if verification fails after two attempts, preventing regressions.
howto.when_en: When your task spans multiple files or systems, Claude activates this skill per protocol.

say_en.text: Refactor the user module step by step with verification.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a checkpoint list and execute sequentially.

say_en.text: Edit config files and verify syntax after each change.
say_en.note: Claude runs a verify command after each checkpoint.
